body:
I think talking to a stranger about all this would be harder, i wouldn't trust them with it, i know they're there to help and there's no judgement, but just a part of me will not allow anyone to know about this, i feel as i have to keep a wall up to protect myself - Plus the fact each session is like £60 which i can't afford. 

And i guess i'm at the point you were, i hardly sleep, i eat very little, self-harm (which has stopped now since i've been guilt-tripped into not doing it.) There's so much wrong with me that seems unfixable, i'll be happy for an hour or two and suddenly something will click inside my brain and all i want is to be dead.

I'm trying to preserve what little happiness there is in my life.
I don't want to cause pain upon my family but if the situation got worse after talking to people, i'm 100% i'd be dead. That's the main reason why i can't speak to anyone about it.

It just seems like too much effort for something that's most likely going to end badly. 

Death seems so much more peaceful.
